card.name: Last digit of round dose numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit, usually 0, of a multi-digit number that is a dose, volume or time amount, as in 150, 200, 480 or 90. It is most common right before mg, mL or seconds.

modes.label: Ending zero of a dose
modes.description: The last 0 of a number such as 50, 150, 200 or 480 in a dosing instruction, right before mg.
modes.example: 5<<0>> mg three times a day or four times

modes.label: Ending digit of a volume or time
modes.description: The last digit of a number in a range of mL or seconds.
modes.example: Start imaging 60 to 9<<0>> seconds after completion

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a dose number, such as the 0 in 150 or 200, just before the unit such as mg or mL.
